objective: Establish whether the F5c backward-facing step steady solve can converge at all, on a detector fine enough to read the answer, before any unsteady solve is proposed for it
rationale: RE-POSED 2026-08-10 in the running agent's words, chief-adopted: YOU CANNOT ASK WHETHER A FLOW IS UNSTEADY UNTIL THE STEADY SOLVE IS SHOWN ABLE TO CONVERGE. The item's original premise was a -10.5% steady miss with wander. Stage A (F5C_STAGE_A_RESULTS.md, 27a94361) withdrew the -10.5% to unmeasured on pre-registered outcome O3, and found what no bar had asked for: no F5c run has ever converged, at any iteration count up to 20,000 - the 8,000-iteration leg sits 66x off its p gate and 847x off Uy, and the original record's 'deep numerical convergence' read the LINEAR solver's final residuals rather than SIMPLE's initial ones. The isolating arm (F5C_LEVER_ISOLATION_RESULTS.md, prereg 9eaefc7f) then proved non-convergence a second way that needs no residual at all: relaxation factors cannot move a converged SIMPLE fixed point, and two solves differing ONLY in relaxation disagree by 4.224 H, a factor of 2.6 in the gate quantity. So half the original premise is withdrawn and half is stronger than ever, and the ordering is wrong rather than the question: an unsteady probe run against a steady baseline that was never converged cannot discriminate a formulation mismatch from an unfinished solve. The wander is real and unmeasured - chief policy forbids any wander verdict from the coarse detector whose wall faces are 0.55-0.81 H apart against a 0.20 H bar, and no xr-* level has ever been run.
gate: One detector-resolved run on xr-coarse (28,300 cells, faces <=0.05 H through the closure region), sampling the x_r history throughout, asking one question: DOES x_r SETTLE AT ALL? Outcome one: it settles, F5c has a reattachment number for the first time, and the unsteady question is answered NO at a fraction of an unsteady solve's cost. Outcome two: it does not settle at a cost the lab will bear, which is the evidence-based case for the unsteady branch and a far stronger one than the premise this item was filed on. Outcome three: it settles but elsewhere, and the case reopens on the number rather than the formulation. The relaxation check is carried as a mandatory second limb, because it is immune to the residual-reading error that produced this entire thread: two runs differing only in relaxation must agree at convergence.
cost_basis: UNPRICEABLE, and recorded as unpriceable rather than estimated. The prior 25 core-min figure is withdrawn. Stage B's 35-39 core-min for xr-coarse at 8,000 iterations is a FLOOR, not an estimate: 8,000 iterations is MEASURED insufficient on the coarse mesh, which is 3.1x cheaper, and 20,000 is measured insufficient there too. A floor is not an estimate, and calling one an estimate is the forecast-basis error the calibration scorecard names as its central finding. What CAN be priced from measurement: a 20,000-iteration xr-coarse run at ~88-97 core-min (basis: 0.084-0.093 s/iteration measured twice on 9,050 cells serial, scaled by 3.127x cells under a stated and falsifiable at-most-linear assumption) buys the x_r history and a convergence-rate curve from which the real cost becomes estimable for the first time.
expected_knowledge_gain: Whether the backward-facing step failure is a steady formulation applied to an unsteady flow, which would close the wandering mystery and reassign the family, or a setup defect that survives both the inlet audit and the unsteady probe, which would narrow the remaining suspect list to something small enough to enumerate

launch_prompt: F5c backward-facing step, unsteady probe. CONTINGENT: do not launch until the inlet-development audit (f5c-inlet-development-audit) has exonerated the inlet on the record. Read demo-output/website/SUPERVISOR_NEGATIVE_VERDICT_REVIEW_2026-08-07.md section 5 and demo-output/website/campaign/F5bc_unsteady_statistics.md first. One pimpleFoam solve of the existing F5c case at a Courant-limited step, long enough for reattachment statistics to separate a stationary mean from a wandering one; probe wall shear along the bottom wall every step. Pre-register both outcomes before launch. Budget 25 core-min and report a partial result rather than spending past it; setsid, poll logs inline. Record: evidence file in demo-output/website/campaign/, docket update on this item, honest verdict.
